# Brief

1. Find the Orc-istration checkout: the "Setup checkout (this machine)" line in the rulebook's tool notes, else `setupCheckout` in `config.json` (under `ORC_DATA_DIR` when set, else under `~/.orc/`), else ask the user. Call it CHECKOUT and confirm `CHECKOUT/orchestration/brief.md` exists there; if it does not, stop and say so.
2. Read `CHECKOUT/orchestration/brief.md` and follow it.
3. On Antigravity this skill is also the slash command `/brief`. Dispatch each roster agent with `invoke_subagent` and its roster name, as the tool notes' Dispatch line says.
